map.杠铃/哑铃配重组合生成器 使用指南: Barbell/Dumbbell Plate Combination Generator User Guide
map.操作：数量 cnt=5，点「生成」。工具随机给出 5 个 5–85 kg 的目标:
Operation: count cnt=5, click 'Generate'. The tool randomly gives 5 target weights of 5-85 kg and automatically fits bar plus plates for each.
Example output (illustrative, random each time): group 3, target 52.5 kg -> bar ...
map.训练前快速生成若干组目标重量的配重方案，省去心算片重组合。: Quickly generate loading plans for several target weights before training, saving mental arithmetic of plate combinations.
map.新手学习标准杠铃片（1.25/2.5/5/10/15/20/25 kg）如何叠加: Beginners learning how standard barbell plates (1.25/2.5/5/10/15/20/25 kg) stack up to a target weight.
map.一次批量出多组不同目标重量，便于超级组/递减组排布。: Generate several groups of different target weights at once, convenient for arranging supersets and drop sets.
map.为什么每次结果不一样？: Why is the result different every time?
map.生成器用随机目标重量与随机片组合，目的是给你多种配重思路；若需固定计划请记下某次: The generator uses random target weights and random plate combinations to give you several loading ideas; if you need a fixed plan, note down one result or plan manually, as this tool does not save generation history.
map.输出「杆 X kg + 配重 A+B+… kg = 实际 Y kg」，配重为双侧: Output 'bar X kg + plates A+B+... kg = actual Y kg', where plates is the total plate weight stacked on both sides (left and right included); in training, load the plates symmetrically on both sides of the bar according to that combination.
